description: Source code defining a segmentation model with convolutional heads, attention mechanisms, and post-processing for segmentation and panoptic outputs, including loss functions.

classes.name: DETRsegm
classes.description: Main segmentation model class combining backbone, transformer, attention, and mask head for object detection and segmentation.

classes.name: MaskHeadSmallConv
classes.description: Convolutional head for mask prediction with upsampling and group normalization.

classes.name: MHAttentionMap
classes.description: 2D attention module returning attention weights with multi-head mechanism.

classes.name: PostProcessSegm
classes.description: Post-processing class for converting model outputs into segmentation masks with thresholding and resizing.

classes.name: PostProcessPanoptic
classes.description: Post-processing class for converting model outputs into panoptic segmentation format compatible with COCO API.

methods.name: dice_loss
methods.description: Computes the DICE loss for mask predictions, similar to generalized IOU.

methods.name: sigmoid_focal_loss
methods.description: Computes the focal loss used in dense detection models like RetinaNet.
